subject: mathematics
officialSource: CISCE ICSE Regulations and Syllabuses (Mathematics Code 51)

chapters.title: Rational and Irrational Numbers
chapters.description: Classification of real numbers, decimal representation, recurring decimals, surds, and rationalising denominators.

levels.title: Rational Numbers & Decimals
levels.description: Understanding terminating and non-terminating recurring decimals in p/q form.

levels.title: Irrational Numbers & Surds
levels.description: Proof of irrationality for square roots and identifying surds.
subtopics: Proof that sqrt(2) and sqrt(3) are irrational

levels.title: Rationalisation of Denominators
levels.description: Conjugate surds and rationalising expressions of the form a / (b + sqrt(c)).

levels.title: Chapter 1 Review & Challenge
levels.description: Comprehensive review of Real Numbers, surds, and proof techniques.

chapters.title: Compound Interest
chapters.description: Compound interest calculations without formula using successive simple interest, and with standard formulae.

levels.title: Compound Interest without Formula
levels.description: Calculating year-by-year simple interest to understand interest accumulation.
subtopics: Difference between Simple and Compound Interest

levels.title: Compound Interest Formula & Rates
levels.description: Using A = P(1 + r/100)^n for annual, half-yearly compounding and varying rates.

levels.title: Population & Depreciation
levels.description: Applications of growth and decay formulae to population and asset depreciation.

levels.title: Chapter 2 Review & Mastery
levels.description: Comprehensive review of commercial compounding problems.

chapters.title: Expansions & Factorisation
chapters.description: Algebraic identities (a+b)^2, (a+b)^3, and factorisation of polynomials.

levels.title: Basic Algebraic Expansions
levels.description: Expansions of (a ± b)^2, (a + b + c)^2, and (x + a)(x + b).

levels.title: Cubic Expansions
levels.description: Expansions of (a ± b)^3 and a^3 ± b^3 conditional identities.

levels.title: Factorisation by Splitting the Middle Term
levels.description: Factoring quadratic trinomials ax^2 + bx + c and grouping terms.

levels.title: Factorisation of Squares and Cubes
levels.description: Factoring difference of squares a^2 - b^2 and sum/difference of cubes a^3 ± b^3.

levels.title: Chapter 3 Review & Challenge
levels.description: Comprehensive review of expansions and factorisation.

chapters.title: Simultaneous Linear Equations
chapters.description: Solving pairs of linear equations in two variables by substitution, elimination, and cross-multiplication, with real-world applications.

levels.title: Method of Elimination & Substitution
levels.description: Solving simultaneous equations algebraically.

levels.title: Equations Reducible to Linear Form
levels.description: Solving fractional equations by substituting u = 1/x and v = 1/y.

levels.title: Word Problems & Practical Applications
levels.description: Translating number problems, age problems, fraction problems, and speed-time problems into linear equations.

levels.title: Chapter 4 Review & Problem Solving
levels.description: Mastery of simultaneous equations and application modeling.

chapters.title: Indices and Logarithms
chapters.description: Laws of positive and fractional indices, introduction to logarithms, and logarithmic laws.

levels.title: Laws of Indices & Fractional Exponents
levels.description: Product law, quotient law, power of power, negative exponents, and fractional exponents a^(m/n).

levels.title: Introduction to Logarithms
levels.description: Definition of logarithm as inverse of exponent: y = a^x <=> log_a(y) = x.

levels.title: Logarithmic Laws & Expansion
levels.description: Product rule log(xy) = log x + log y, quotient rule, power rule, and base change formula.

levels.title: Chapter 5 Review & Mastery
levels.description: Review of exponents and logarithms.

chapters.title: Triangles & Pythagoras Theorem
chapters.description: Congruency criteria (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS), Mid-point theorem, intercept theorem, and Pythagoras theorem proofs & applications.

levels.title: Congruency of Triangles
levels.description: Understanding and applying SSS, SAS, ASA, and RHS criteria with formal proofs.

levels.title: Mid-point & Intercept Theorem
levels.description: Line segment joining mid-points of two sides is parallel to the third side and half of it.

levels.title: Pythagoras Theorem & Applications
levels.description: In a right-angled triangle, hypotenuse^2 = base^2 + perpendicular^2 and its converse.
subtopics: Calculations in right triangles and geometric figures

levels.title: Chapter 6 Review & Geometric Proofs
levels.description: Review of triangles, mid-point theorem, and Pythagoras applications.

chapters.title: Mensuration (Area & Volume)
chapters.description: Perimeter and area of triangles (Heron's formula), quadrilaterals, circle, and surface area & volume of cubes and cuboids.

levels.title: Area of Triangles & Heron's Formula
levels.description: Calculating area using 1/2 * base * height and Heron's formula sqrt(s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)).

levels.title: Quadrilaterals & Circles
levels.description: Area and perimeter of rectangles, squares, parallelograms, rhombuses, trapeziums, and circles.

levels.title: Surface Area & Volume of Cubes & Cuboids
levels.description: Total surface area, lateral surface area, volume, and diagonal length of rectangular solids.
subtopics: TSA and LSA of cubes and cuboids

levels.title: Chapter 7 Review & Mensuration Challenges
levels.description: Combined real-world mensuration word problems.

chapters.title: Trigonometric Ratios
chapters.description: Sine, Cosine, Tangent, Cosecant, Secant, Cotangent of acute angles in a right triangle, and values at 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°.

levels.title: Introduction to Trigonometric Ratios
levels.description: Definitions of sin, cos, tan, cosec, sec, cot as ratios of sides of a right triangle.

levels.title: Values for Standard Angles
levels.description: Trigonometric ratio values at 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, and 90°.

levels.title: Coordinate Geometry Basics
levels.description: Cartesian coordinate system, quadrants, signs of coordinates, plotting points, and distance from axes.

levels.title: Chapter 8 Review & Trigonometry Mastery
levels.description: Review of trigonometric ratios, standard angles, and coordinate plotting.
